package.description: On-prem test automation for web, API, Android and iOS

en-US.description: On-prem test automation for web, API, Android and iOS
en-US.longDescription:
Tester is an on-premises test automation appliance. One suite written in plain
language drives web browsers, HTTP APIs, Android devices and iOS from the same
file, and AI test generation runs on local models, so test data, credentials and
pre-release builds never leave your network.

Built for regulated teams whose security policy rules out cloud test platforms.
Enterprise controls are included: SSO over OIDC and SAML, SCIM provisioning,
multi-project RBAC, metadata-only audit, signed updates and signed licence
entitlements. External AI providers are strictly opt-in and show a redaction
preview before anything leaves the appliance.
en-US.name: Tester by Alcyone Systems
